description: This file defines an interface for building responses to retrieve attribute commands in a live signals processing context, specifically for the RetrieveAttribute command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested interfaces for creating responses with attribute values or error responses.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command answer responses related to retrieving attributes in a live signal command context.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: A nested interface responsible for creating specific response objects, such as attribute values or error responses, for RetrieveAttribute commands.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved attribute value.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the attribute does not exist or access is denied.
